messages.subject: subregion in line  transect survey
parts:
Hi.

It it possible to define subregions in Distance?

I have a enclosed survey area with sub-enclosures in a 3 treatment (control, low and high) block design with 3 replicates.

I have made transect analyses with treatment as stratum but was wondering if it is possible to define sub-enclosures in the data-fil for import so I can density estimates for each sub-anclosure?
